sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: A roll to react to danger or pressure rather than initiate action.
When: Use when the GM calls for a response to sudden danger.
Not When: Do not use as a default defense roll against every attack.
Question: Is this a saving throw?
Answer: Usually yes: if you mean a D&D save, look for a Reaction Roll.
Example: Dodging a sudden falling branch can be a Reaction Roll.
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
